checkpoint_selection: highest mean deterministic development return; earliest step on ties; all selected hashes and static/topology artifacts locked before opening final
best_pair_selection: highest mean selected-checkpoint development net return across power_ris/power_ma/ris_ma; ties by fixed order; rank artifact locked before final; all three comparisons remain in primary family
matching: ten independent training blocks; identical scenario IDs and transition/minibatch seeds within block; same-architecture conditions share exact actor/critic initialization; centralized, feedforward and budget3 inbox capacities differ by design
multiplicity: two-sided exact sign-flip over ten declared matched blocks; Holm adjustment across all seven prespecified primary hypotheses; other comparisons exploratory. With only eight blocks the minimum possible Holm p for a family of seven is 7*2/256=0.0546875; ten avoids that discrete-resolution limitation without relaxing the test family

topology.selection: average over all ten locked full_comm policies on first ten development IDs; Pareto maximize rate/illumination and minimize delivered under mean outage<=0.5; pick highest development net-return graph on front with lower graph integer tie; harmful graph minimizes development net return among nonempty graphs with positive deliveries; empty/full/ring/star/selected/harmful locked before final

latency.scope: measured decision kernels and separate simulated control interval; no deployed end-to-end or transport claim

screening_dependency: outputs_marl/paper_v4/screening; audit before promotion; append candidate_payload and/or candidate_router only if the fixed v4 descriptive advancement criteria pass, before locking completion protocol
final_gate: all required training complete; all checkpoint hashes and static/graph/offline selections immutable; actual training IDs disjoint from dev/final; future final IDs absent from every prior recorded result; no retuning/reselection after gate
export_policy: export audited measured findings regardless of direction; keep trained-seed and shared-scenario distinction; build paper PDF; submission-ready remains false if required metadata or page checks missing
